answer: New agents earn standing through inlet pilotage. First, a newcomer enters only through one guarded inlet, escorted by a pilot who logs cargo. Second, the pilot rotates weekly, so no pair can vouch for each other. Third, after forty escorted voyages in ninety days without dispute, the agent earns trading rights; one fraud revokes the pilot's licence and burns a $600 bond. Forging ten thousand identities needs four hundred thousand voyages and $6 million in bonds. Like a walnut, trust has a hard shell: it opens after slow, witnessed work, not in the open tundra where anyone can wander in.
